title: Grateful Dead Live at Alfred College on 1970-05-01
lineage: SBD > MR > DAT > Sonic Solutions > CDR

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard recording of the legendary Alfred College show with scorching New Speedway Boogie and hot Cold Jordan performances
ai_review.review: The SBD capture is praised for its crisp, crystal‑clear mix – many reviewers call it “the best live sound ever” despite a minor cut on Lovelight. Musically the night shines with Jerry’s blistering trade licks on New Speedway Boogie, tight acoustic work from Bob and Jerry early in the set, and standout jams of Cold Jordan and The Other One, making it one of the must‑listen 1970 gems.

ai_rating.rationale: Over thirty reviews overwhelmingly rate the show 4–5 stars, highlighting excellent performance and superb soundboard quality; only a few neutral/technical comments lower the average slightly.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clear mix with outstanding instrument separation (two acoustic guitars in L/R). Reviewers note it as “best live sound ever” and “great crystal‑clear acoustic set”. Minor issues: Lovelight is cut at 5:30; one comment mentions the sound could be a touch better.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Starts with an acoustic duo (Jerry, Bob and a second acoustic – likely David Nelson) on songs like Race Is On and Wake Up Little Susie, then shifts to electric power with New Speedway Boogie, Cold Jordan, The Other One and Pigpen, showcasing fluid transitions between folk‑rock and full‑band jams.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for fiery trade licks on New Speedway Boogie and strong guitar tone throughout.
band_member_comments.Bob: Highlighted on the early acoustic numbers (Race Is On, Wake Up Little Susie) sharing rhythm duties with Jerry.
